concerns.text: FR-011 (Trait Data Integration & Gate) and FR-006 (Defense Allocation Index) lack implementation tasks. T025a, T025b, T038a, and T025c are marked as incomplete (unchecked) in the tasks list, meaning the pipeline cannot fetch traits, merge them, or execute the mandatory >30% missing data gate required by the spec.

FR-017 (Phylogenetic Null Model) and FR-007 (PGLS validation) lack a complete implementation task. T028a (Phylogeny Fetcher) is marked incomplete. Without fetching the phylogenetic tree, the null model generation and PGLS validation described in the spec cannot be executed.

SC-002 (DE gene reproducibility) and FR-002 (Reproducibility check) lack a complete implementation task. T040 is marked incomplete. The spec requires calculating Jaccard similarity against published lists, but the task to implement `src/analysis/reproducibility.py` is not present in the completed task list.

FR-016 (Power Analysis) lacks a complete implementation task. T026 is marked incomplete. The spec mandates a power analysis gate prior to modeling; without this task, the pipeline cannot halt on insufficient power as required.

FR-012 (Pathway Aggregation) has incomplete task coverage. T037 (Pathway Aggregation logic) is marked incomplete. While T021 references it, the actual implementation task to map DE genes to pathways and reduce features to ≤50 is not marked as done, creating a gap in the feature derivation pipeline.

Tasks T025a, T025b, and T028a contain malformed API URLs in their descriptions (e.g., ` Name or service not known)"))]. These appear to be copy-paste errors or truncation artifacts that obscure the actual implementation logic, though the task intent is visible.
